summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a lease agreement between Highlands REIT (registrant) and GEO Secure Services for a property in Hudson, CO. The lease commences August 1, 2026, with an 88-month term. Base rent starts at $250,000/month, increasing to $958,333.33/month upon occupancy or six-month anniversary, then 3% annual escalations. A rent reduction clause exists if a third-party agreement terminates. The filing is a routine material definitive agreement (commercial lease) and does not involve an M&A, restructuring, or other special situation. No financial terms beyond rent and taxes are disclosed. The lease is operational, not a transformative event.
